_comment: STATUS (2026-08-11): RETAINED FOR REFERENCE / FALLBACK ONLY.
This is NOT the active config for any current training script.
scripts/train/train_stage2_full.sh moved to scripts/zero2.json when the
project gained 4x A100-80GB (320 GB total); at that scale full FT of
Vicuna-7B fits in ZeRO-2 at ~38-42 GB/GPU of model states, so ZeRO-3 and
CPU offload are pure PCIe slowdown for no memory benefit.
Keep this file: it is the fallback if GPU access regresses to small-VRAM
hardware (it was load-bearing on 2x RTX 4090 24 GB). Reactivating it also
reimposes a >=128 GB HOST RAM requirement for the ~100 GB of CPU-side
offload buffers (~84 GB Adam + ~14 GB params).
NOTE: transformers' HfDeepSpeedConfig parses this with strict json.load,
so // and # comments break it - this _comment key is the only safe form.
